text:
eva: deploybot flagged a rise in p95 latency and kvcache misses right after the q8 kernel flag rollout to v6.0.0 on embeddings-heavy routes. deploybot recommends cutting traffic for the q8-enabled variant. proposing a targeted snip + pin to limit blast radius. thoughts?

deploybot: Recommendation: route-snip q8-variant -> revert traffic to non-q8 v5.9.3 for affected routes (confidence 0.87). signals: p95 +260ms, kvcache miss +20%. auto-action requires operator.

sanjay: oncall. +1 to targeted snip. prefer 40% -> 100% step to avoid queue pressure. will monitor traces.

ehilary: looped in. Legal not needed yet; prepare neutral customer text.

eva: planned commands:
```
redwoodctl traffic split --env prod --routes embeddings-hosted,embeddings-dedicated --from v6.0.0-q8 --to v5.9.3 --pct-start 40 --pct-final 100 --step-interval 3m --reason "q8 kvcache regression"
redwoodctl pin --env prod --version v5.9.3 --routes embeddings-hosted,embeddings-dedicated --ttl 45m --reason "safety pin after q8 rollback"
redwoodctl feature toggle --env staging --flag kernel_q8 --state off --reason "repro + triage"
```

sanjay: kicking job now. monitoring dashboards and trace sampler.

deploybot: Job jb-99012 queued. step1 40% shifting started. ETA per step ~40s.

sanjay: step1 done: 40% shifted, p95 improved ~30%. proceeding to remaining steps in 3m unless we see regression.

sanjay: stepping to 100% early; observed steady improvement.

deploybot: Shift complete: 100% -> v5.9.3 for target routes. p95 back to baseline ~130ms. kvcache miss normalizing.

eva: applied pin for 45m and disabled auto-rollforward for the routes. opened INF-6118 for RCA (assigning sanjay + eva + runtime).

comms-bot: Draft incident update queued: "We temporarily routed a subset of traffic to a previous model variant after detecting increased latency following a kernel optimization flag. No customer data exposed."

ops-bot: Posted incident stub to #statuspage and triggered customer template "embeddings-q8-rollback".

sanjay: next steps: reproduce in staging with kernel_q8 on, collect KV traces, test a patched q8 build with additional cache warmup. if repro succeeds, prepare canary patch.

eva: disabling scheduled auto-canary for v6.0.0 until we validate fixes. closing execution thread for now; will update INF-6118 with RCA timeline. :white_check_mark:
